remarks: One of the most coveted pieces of land in all of Westport Connecticut. Almost 3 Acres of pristine unspoiled FLAT TO WATERFRONT property along the stunning Saugatuck River famous for its fishing. Surrounded by MULTI-MILLION DOLLAR homes at the end of a Cul De Sac. Build your dream home here, or develop and flip for a handsome profit. Enjoy the sounds every day of a rolling river and the smell of fresh mature foliage. 400 FEET of crystal clear rolling river frontage will be your home's view. Explore your own small private island. Drive up to a hand-carved granite driveway and marvel at large trees and flowering bushes and plantings. Our seller has developed preliminarily APPROVED PLANS for a stunning home of steel and glass so that all rooms of the home, even the garage, have majestic views of the river. Those plans are available for the whomever purchases!!!  Use 2 Pan Handle Lane Westport For Easy Navigation GPS!
